name: Northwest Territories
short: The Arctic Energy Alliance pays after-purchase rebates for NWT homes: up to $8,000 for exterior wall insulation, $1,500 for ceilings, 50% up to $2,000 for a wood or pellet stove, and $700 for drain water heat recovery. Renewable projects such as solar and ground-source heat pumps can get up to $20,000 with approval. We found no AEA rebate for air-source heat pumps.

rows.rules: Mail-in rebate. Application form and receipts.
Mail in within 3 months of purchase.
Pre-approval. Lower of 50% of cost or a savings calculation.
